Which of the above could be the graph of $y=6{x}^{6}+2{x}^{3}+0.5x+1?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's call $P(x)$ the given polynomial:

$$
P(x)=6{x}^{6}+2{x}^{3}+0.5x+1
$$

The degree $(n=6)$ is even and the leading coefficient $({a}_{6}=6)$ is positive. Therefore, the polynomial has the following end behavior:

- $P(x)\to \infty $ as $x\to -\infty .$

- $P(x)\to \infty $ as $x\to \infty .$

None of the graphs satisfies these conditions.
